fail_class_labels.max_turns: Turn limit reached — the harness cut the run off
fail_class_labels.limits_exceeded: Step or cost limit reached — the harness stopped the run
fail_class_labels.mse: Wrong numbers — error above the correctness threshold
fail_class_labels.gpu: The GPU was idle — the work did not run on it
fail_class_labels.no_solution: No solution.json — the agent never wrote the artifact
fail_class_labels.thinking_block: Provider rejected the assistant's thinking block
fail_class_labels.toolchain_missing: A build tool is missing from the image
fail_class_labels.make_config_stop: Make stopped after writing config.mk and was never re-run
fail_class_labels.empty_response: Provider returned no text or tool call
fail_class_labels.cut_off: Cut off — no final assistant message
fail_class_labels.format_error: Too many malformed tool calls in a row — the harness gave up
fail_class_labels.make_no_rule: Make has no rule for a required target
fail_class_labels.build_error: The build failed for an unrecognised reason
fail_class_labels.run_timeout: The graded run outlived its 10 minute cap
fail_class_labels.perf: Too slow against the reference kernel
fail_class_labels.ptxas_error: The CUDA assembler (ptxas) rejected the kernel
fail_class_labels.hung_after_final: Hung after its final reply — the harness ended it
